uutiset.t: US Stock Futures Rally as Nvidia Results Ease AI Trade Worries
uutiset.s: US technology stocks rallied before the open on Wednesday as Nvidia Corp.’s earnings assuaged concerns following the exit of former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, boosting confidence in the durability of the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Puts Wall Street’s Speculation Factory on Display
uutiset.s: Anthropic’s initial public offering, set to price Wednesday, is the final step in a time-tested process that brings a company from private hands into the public market.

uutiset.t: Lithium Miner Warns of Perils Facing US Critical Minerals Push
uutiset.s: Lithium Americas Corp.’s flagship US mine has become an expensive test of the Trump administration’s push to rebuild a domestic critical minerals industry, with labor shortages, rising wages and tariffs pushing its construction bill almost $900 million higher.

uutiset.t: ECB's Vujcic Says December Rate Hike Looks 'Very Likely'
uutiset.s: European Central Bank Vice President Boris Vujcic says a December rate hike looks highly probable and more increases may follow in 2027 as inflation broadens. He made the comments during an interview with Bloomberg's Mark Schroers. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Davidson Kempner Warns of Credit Markets 'Fear Factor'
uutiset.s: As concerns mount in fixed-income markets, Chris Krishanthan, who co-manages the global credit department at Davidson Kempner, says "there’s a real fear factor that developed." He made the comments at Bloomberg's Global Credit Forum in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Crypto Futures Point to a Big Pop for Anthropic Stock
uutiset.s: Bulls on AI are driving huge demand for the IPO.

uutiset.t: Credit Chiefs Warn of ‘Fear Factor’ as Debt Reprices All at Once
uutiset.s: A sharp repricing across fixed-income markets in recent months is likely to continue as interest rates remain elevated, causing a shakeout among weaker borrowers across industries.

uutiset.t: Rand Leads Emerging-Market Losses as Gold Drops Below $3,800
uutiset.s: The rand fell to its weakest level against the dollar in seven months after headwinds including steep drop in gold prices cooled sentiment toward South African assets.

uutiset.t: How GTA VI Became the Most Expensive Video Game Ever Made
uutiset.s: One of the biggest entertainment releases in history.

uutiset.t: How GTA VI Became the Most Expensive Video Game Ever Made
uutiset.s: It took over a decade to make Grand Theft Auto VI. And when it’s released on November 19, it will have likely already set at least one record: the most expensive video game ever made. uutiset.t: Xi Welcomes Trump at Shenzhen Airport
uutiset.s: President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping shared a cheek-to-cheek hug in a rare airport welcome in Shenzhen. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: India Studies Investors’ Tax Proposals to Boost Equity Trading
uutiset.s: Indian revenue officials are reviewing proposals from investors and economists to raise taxes on stock derivatives while lowering levies on share trading, in a bid to curb speculative bets and encourage broader participation in the equity market, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

uutiset.t: Ex-Longview Manager to Bet on Handful of Stocks in New Fund
uutiset.s: Katie Moran has an unconventional metric for equity selection at her boutique hedge fund: the few stocks making the grade will have passed a test of their “element of delight.”

uutiset.t: Treasuries Edge Higher for a Third Day as Risk Appetite Falters
uutiset.s: Benchmark US Treasuries edged higher for a third day, supported by subdued risk sentiment and speculation that most of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate hikes may already be in the price.

uutiset.t: Copper and Tin Plunge as AI Trade Unravels in Metals Markets
uutiset.s: Copper plunged during a heavy selloff on the London Metal Exchange, with bullish investors bailing on bets linked to the AI boom and others turning outright bearish even in the face of extreme squeezes that are rocking metals markets.
